description: This file contains functions for generating and managing boot configuration arguments for Android virtual devices in the Cuttlefish project. It includes logic for configuring boot parameters based on device instance settings, VM manager, and hardware features.

methods.name: AppendMapWithReplacement
methods.description: Template function to merge two maps, replacing existing keys in the destination with values from the source.

methods.name: ConsoleBootconfig
methods.description: Generates boot configuration arguments related to console settings based on the device instance.

methods.name: BootconfigArgsFromConfig
methods.description: Main function to generate a map of boot configuration arguments based on the device configuration and instance settings.

methods.name: BootconfigArgsString
methods.description: Converts the boot configuration arguments map into a string with specified separator.
